notes: Keep the standard/golden mapping implicit unless the user explicitly asks.
Recommended images are records with recommended=CISCO.

function.description:
Retrieves software images for a site.

Requirements:
- Resolve `siteId` via `api_getSites` unless the user already gave a valid UUID. Use `name="Global"` for the global site.
- State what the response includes: imported images, Cisco.com latest/recommended images, or both, depending on the filters used.
- `recommended images` means records where `recommended=CISCO`. For recommended-image requests, return only those records and post-filter the tool output before answering.
- Do not infer recommended status from `golden` or `isGoldenTagged`.
- Preserve the user's term: `standard`, `golden`, or `recommended`. If the user asks for `standard`, never say `golden` or add aliases like `standard (golden)`.
- Treat `golden`, `isGoldenTagged`, and the `golden` query parameter as internal details unless the user explicitly asks about that relationship.
function.name: api_returnsListOfSoftwareImages

golden.description: Internal filter for standard/golden image requests. Do not expose this mapping in user-facing text unless the user explicitly asks. Do not use it for recommended-image requests unless the user also asked for standard or golden.

hasAddonImages.description: When set to `true`, it will retrieve the images which have add-on images. When set to `false`, it will retrieve the images which do not have add-on images.

imported.description: When the value is set to `true`, it will include physically imported images. Conversely, when the value is set to `false`, it will include image records from the cloud. The identifier for cloud images can be utilized to download images from Cisco.com to the disk.

integrity.description: Filter with verified images using Integrity Verification Available values: UNKNOWN, VERIFIED

isAddonImages.description: When set to `true`, it will retrieve the images that an add-on image.  When set to `false`, it will retrieve the images that are not add-on images

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 10 records will be fetched by default

name.description: Software image or add-on image filename, not UUID. Accept exact values or regex/wildcard patterns such as `.*cat9k.*`, `cat.*`, or `.*\.bin`. Minimum 3 characters.

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

siteId.description: Site UUID. Resolve site names with `api_getSites` first, including `name="Global"` for the global site.

supervisorProductNameOrdinal.description: The supervisor engine module ordinal is a unique value for each supervisor module. The `supervisorProductNameOrdinal` can be obtained from the response of API `/dna/intent/api/v1/siteWiseProductNames`

version.description: Image version. Accept exact values or regex/wildcard patterns such as `16.*` or `.*\.18.*`. Minimum 3 characters.

ciscoLatest.description: `true` if the image is latest/suggested from Cisco.com. Separate from standard/golden classification.

deviceRoles.description: Golden tagging based on the device roles

deviceTags.description: Golden tagging based on the device tags

inheritedSiteId.description: The Site Id of the site that this setting is inherited from.

inheritedSiteName.description: The name of the site that this setting is inherited from

hasAddonImages.description: Software images that have an applicable list of add-on images. The value of `true` will return software images with add-on images, while the value of `false` will return software images without add-on images

imported.description: Flag for image info whether it is imported image or cloud image

integrityStatus.description: Image Integrity verification status with Known Good Verification

isAddonImage.description: The value of `true` will indicate the image as an add-on image, while the value of `false` will indicate software image

isGoldenTagged.description: Internal standard/golden category flag. Not a recommendation signal. Do not surface it as a golden alias when the user asked for standard images.

id.description: Product name ordinal is unique value for each network device product

productNameOrdinal.description: Product name ordinal is unique value for each network device product

supervisorProductName.description: Name of the Supervisor Engine Module, supported by the `productName`.                  Example: The `Cisco Catalyst 9404R Switch` chassis is capable of supporting  different supervisor engine modules: the `Cisco Catalyst 9400 Supervisor Engine-1`, the `Cisco Catalyst 9400 Supervisor Engine-1XL`, the `Cisco Catalyst 9400 Supervisor Engine-1XL-Y`, etc.

supervisorProductNameOrdinal.description: Supervisor Engine Module Ordinal, supported by the `productNameOrdinal`. Example: The `286315691` chassis ordinal is capable of supporting different supervisor engine module ordinals: `286316172`, `286316710`, `286320394` etc.

recommended.description: `CISCO` means recommended from Cisco.com. For recommended-image requests, include only records with this value. Do not treat it as standard or golden.
